scene_zh: 一群学生的备考记录（模拟数据）

views.subject: study hours and test scores
views.subtitle_en: Weekly study hours plotted against test scores.

examples.en: Scores rise with study hours: 4 hours a week brings 52 points, and 16 hours brings 90.
examples.zh: 分数随学习时长上升：每周 4 小时得 52 分，16 小时得 90 分。

features.note_zh: 描述整体同向变化用 rise with / go together，不写 cause。
features.interpret_zh: 整体同向很明显，但个体差异大，18 小时只有 52 分的点就是例外。

examples.en: Through the first 8 hours the dots sit close to a line: 2 hours brings 48 points, 8 hours brings 70.
examples.zh: 前 8 小时的点和一条线贴得很近：2 小时 48 分，8 小时 70 分。

features.note_zh: sit close to a line 形象地说点贴近趋势线。
features.interpret_zh: 这一段最整齐，但能上 8 小时的学生本身可能基础更好。

examples.en: The middle is crowded: students who study 9 to 13 hours score 68 to 85.
examples.zh: 中间区域很密：学 9 到 13 小时的学生得 68 到 85 分。

features.note_zh: crowded / dense band 描述点集中，不说成 correlation。
features.interpret_zh: 大多数样本落在这一段，比较分数时先看自己是否也在区间内。

examples.en: Above 14 hours the dots flatten out: 14 hours brings 83 points and 17 hours brings 89.
examples.zh: 14 小时以上的点变平：14 小时 83 分，17 小时 89 分。

features.note_zh: flatten out / level off 表示增长放缓，比 stop rising 更准确。
features.interpret_zh: 再往上加时长的收益变小，还可能挤掉睡眠和复习效率。

examples.en: One student studied 18 hours and scored 52, far below the trend.
examples.zh: 有一名学生学了 18 小时，只考了 52 分，远低于趋势。

features.note_zh: far below the trend / clear outlier；先给位置，再给数值。
features.interpret_zh: 时长最长的反而分数最低，可能记录有误，也可能时间没用对，图里看不出来。

views.overview_zh: 分数整体随学习时长上升，前 8 小时最整齐；9 到 13 小时样本最密；14 小时后明显变平，还有一个 18 小时只得 52 分的离群点。相关不等于因果。

general.a2: Students who study more usually score higher. Two hours a week brings about 48 points, and 16 hours brings about 90. One student studied 18 hours but scored only 52.
general.b1: Scores climb with study time from 48 points at 2 hours to 90 at 16 hours. The pattern is tight up to about 13 hours, then flattens. One outlier at 18 hours scored just 52.
general.b2: The scatter shows a strong positive association between weekly study hours and test scores, rising from 48 points at 2 hours to 92 at 16. Most points cluster between 9 and 13 hours. The pattern levels off after 14 hours, and a single observation at 18 hours scored only 52.

descriptions.ielts: Test scores rose steadily with weekly study hours, from 48 points at 2 hours to 92 at 16 hours. Most students studied between 9 and 13 hours, scoring 68 to 85. One student who studied 18 hours scored only 52.
descriptions.business: Scores track study hours closely up to about 13 hours a week, then flatten. The marginal hour beyond 14 hours buys little, and the 18-hour case scoring 52 is worth checking before setting any study target.

views.subject: Average score by weekly study hours
views.subtitle_en: Average score in each weekly study band.

examples.en: The 13–16 hour band has the highest average, at 86.3 points.
examples.zh: 13 到 16 小时这一档平均分最高，为 86.3 分。

features.note_zh: the highest average；average 前加 the。
features.interpret_zh: 这一档平均最高，但组内差距可能很大，散点图里能看到。

examples.en: The 0–4 hour band scores 52.6, the lowest average.
examples.zh: 0 到 4 小时这一档为 52.6 分，平均分最低。

features.note_zh: the lowest / at the bottom；lowest 后可以省略名词。
features.interpret_zh: 学得最少的一组平均分最低，但低分也可能来自缺考或基础差。

examples.en: The 9–12 hour band ranks second, at 75.0 points.
examples.zh: 9 到 12 小时这一档排第二，为 75.0 分。

features.note_zh: rank + 序数词，不加 the；come second 更口语。
features.interpret_zh: 排第二的这一档人数可能最多，平均分更能代表常见情况。

examples.en: The 5–8 hour band scores 63.0, 23.3 points below the 13–16 hour band.
examples.zh: 5 到 8 小时这一档为 63.0 分，比 13 到 16 小时低 23.3 分。

features.note_zh: X points below / above 直接说差距，不用 higher 修饰 points。
features.interpret_zh: 多学四小时就差 23 分，是这张图里跨度最大的一段。

examples.en: The 17–20 hour band drops to 70.5, 15.8 points below the peak band.
examples.zh: 17 到 20 小时这一档降到 70.5 分，比最高档低 15.8 分。

features.note_zh: drop to / fall below；peak band 指最高的那一档。
features.interpret_zh: 学得最多的一档在这组数据里反而更低，说明时长不是越多越好。

views.overview_zh: 平均分先升后降：0 到 4 小时 52.6 分，13 到 16 小时 86.3 分最高，17 到 20 小时回落到 70.5 分。分组平均会掩盖组内差异。

general.a2: Average scores go up with more study hours, then fall. The 13–16 hour group is highest at 86.3 points. The 17–20 hour group is lower, at 70.5. The 0–4 hour group starts at 52.6.
general.b1: Average scores rise from 52.6 points in the 0–4 hour band to 86.3 in the 13–16 hour band, then drop to 70.5 for 17–20 hours. The 9–12 hour band comes second at 75.0.
general.b2: Average scores climb steadily across the bands, from 52.6 points at 0–4 hours to a peak of 86.3 at 13–16 hours, before falling to 70.5 at 17–20 hours. The 33.7-point gap between the lowest and highest bands is the largest in the chart.

descriptions.ielts: Average scores were lowest in the 0–4 hour band, at 52.6 points, and highest in the 13–16 hour band, at 86.3. The 17–20 hour band recorded 70.5, well below the 9–12 hour band at 75.0.
descriptions.business: Average scores peak at 86.3 points for 13–16 hours a week and fall to 70.5 beyond that. The 0–4 hour band sits 33.7 points lower. Band averages hide a wide spread, so targets should be set with the individual data in view.
